TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.TITLE: AI Agent Assistant
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DESCRIPTION: Builds an AI Agent's Training and checks that the engine will actually be able to run it before you save.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.UNSUPPORTED_HINT: There are saved sources the assistant doesn't know how to offer and won't use:
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.PHRASES_HINT: Verbatim, typos and all. Each topic's description is written in these words, so the agent recognises real messages rather than manual language.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.PHRASES_EMPTY: No customer messages yet to use as a reference.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.EMPTY_ACCOUNT_TITLE: This account has nothing to build an agent from yet.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.EMPTY_ACCOUNT_HINT: You need at least one Knowledge Base source or one case type. Without that, the assistant has nothing to propose from and could only offer generic templates.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.ERROR_FORBIDDEN: Only an administrator can use the AI Agent Assistant.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.ERROR_GENERIC: Couldn't read what this account has. Please try again.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.REPORT_EMPTY: Once there's a Training written, you'll see here what the engine recognises.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.DRAFT_PLACEHOLDER: The assistant writes it, and you can edit it by hand: it's checked as you type.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.INPUT_PLACEHOLDER: Tell it what you want the agent to do…
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.SAVE_REPLACE_HINT: A copy of the previous Training is kept, in case you need to go back.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.ERROR_NO_KEY: This account has no OpenAI integration configured, so the assistant can't write.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.AUDIT_HINT: Every saved agent, run through the same checker. \u201cConversational\u201d is not a defect: it's an agent with no declared topics, answering with the model alone.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.SAVE_NAME_TAKEN: An AI Agent with that name already exists in this account. Pick another one.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.SAVE_CONTEXT_HINT: Business facts you mentioned in the conversation. Empty is fine: the assistant doesn't fill in what you didn't tell it, because the agent would quote it as true.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.SAVE_FROM_TEMPLATE: This Training came from “%{name}”. Saving replaces its own and keeps a copy of the previous one.
TRACKING_ASSISTANT_VIEW.SESSIONS_HINT: A good Training rarely comes out in one sitting. Here you can go back to a conversation, finished or not.
